description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across different categories in the SALT dataset, comparing the number of sentences in thousands (K) across eight distinct categories. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Sentences (K)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, with tick labels at intervals of 200. Each category is represented by a salmon-colored bar, with the height corresponding to the number of sentences in thousands. The bar heights vary significantly, with the shortest bar representing Blogs at approximately 2K sentences, and the tallest bar representing News at approximately 902K sentences. Other notable values include Administrative at 525K, Non-fiction at 190K, and Science at 110K, while Religion, Fiction, and Law have relatively shorter bars at 50K, 35K, and 23K, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. The chart provides a clear representation of the distribution of sentences across the different categories, with the exact values displayed above each bar.
